title: Luca, the little sea monster.
lines: Deep in the sea, near a beautiful coast in Italy, lives a boy.
But Luca isn't an ordinary boy.
Luca is a little sea monster!
He has blue scales, a finny tail and big eyes.
He herds a flock of fish.
Just like a shepherd herds sheep.
Mum says: Never go up to the surface.
That's where the land monsters live.
He finds things that come from up there.
One day Luca meets another little sea monster.
He goes up to the surface all the time.
He pulls Luca out of the water.
As soon as Luca is dry, he changes.
But when he gets wet, he turns back into a sea monster.
Alberto and Luca build a scooter out of old junk.
They dream of a real Vespa.
With it they could see the whole world.
They go to the little village by the sea.
There's a square with a fountain.
She wants to win a race.
With the prize money they can buy a Vespa.
Luca learns to ride a bike.
Giulia also teaches him about the stars and the planets.
Luca wants to go to school!
But the boys have to be careful.
Then everyone will see that they're sea monsters.
On the day of the race it starts to rain.
But Luca just keeps on cycling.
At first they get a fright.
But then they see that Luca and Alberto are kind.
Alberto doesn't buy a Vespa for himself.
He buys a train ticket for Luca.
That way Luca can go to school, with Giulia.
But he knows for sure that he and Alberto will always be friends.
